title: Slovakian Beef Burger
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired burger featuring tender beef, rich flavors, and a hint of smokiness.

ingredients.name: Ground beef (500g)
ingredients.notes: High-quality beef with a fat content of 15%

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for best flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, smoked paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the beef mixture into 4 equal portions and shape each into a ball. Flatten each ball slightly into a patty.
Place the patties onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the burgers are baking, toast the buns by brushing them with unsalted butter and placing them under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Spread a layer of caraway mayonnaise onto the bottom bun, followed by a cooked burger patty, a few slices of red cabbage, and finally the top bun.
Garnish each burger with chopped fresh chives and serve immediately.
